sentiment.rationale: The document reports record adjusted EBITDA of $1.9 billion, up 35% year-on-year, and free cash flow of $2.3 billion. Management expresses confidence in the outlook, with Q2 guidance indicating 'strong top line growth, combined with even stronger profitability growth.' However, the guidance is not formally raised above prior expectations; it is described as 'more of the same,' and the Q&A reveals that Mobility Gross Bookings growth decelerated slightly due to pricing and mix. The score reflects genuine operational momentum and confident forward language, but without a formal guidance raise, it stays in the +0.15 to +0.3 range.

summary.revenue: Not disclosed as a single revenue figure. Gross Bookings grew in line with trips, up 18% year-on-year. Mobility trip growth was 19% year-over-year for the last three quarters.
summary.guidance: Q2 outlook expects 'strong top line growth, combined with even stronger profitability growth.' Mobility trip growth expected to be around 19% year-over-year. Insurance cost headwind expected to be high-single digits through 2025.
summary.margin: Record adjusted EBITDA of $1.9 billion, up 35% year-on-year. Delivery margins at 3.7% of Gross Bookings, up 70 bps year-over-year. All-time high margins for Mobility in the quarter.
key_risks: Insurance costs remain a headwind, though moderating to high-single digits in 2025.
Macroeconomic uncertainty from trade and economic policy headlines.
Competitive intensity globally in both Mobility and Delivery.
Higher mix of international trips due to lower inbound US travel, which comes with lower Gross Bookings per trip.
key_opportunities: Autonomous vehicle partnerships with Waymo, May Mobility, VW, Momenta, Avride, and others, with deployments in US, Europe, and Middle East.
Expansion into less dense (sparser) markets, which represent 20% of Mobility trips and are growing faster than core urban markets.
Delivery margin expansion driven by advertising and scale, with grocery and retail now accretive at variable contribution level.
Membership program with 30 million members, delivering billions in discounts and increasing penetration.
Merchant-funded offers driving higher Gross Bookings growth in Delivery.
New products like two-wheelers, three-wheelers, Taxi, and shared rides extending growth runway.

management_tone.label: confident
